summary: Tested and fixed multiple bug fixes for ClauseGuard app. Fixed MongoDB ObjectId serialization issues in annotations, saved-searches, and favorites endpoints. All 19 backend tests pass. All frontend UI tests pass including Dashboard button visibility, AI toggle behavior, PDF export, and note saving.

Dashboard button visible on SearchResults page (Bug #5 FIXED)
Dashboard button visible on ClauseDetail page (Bug #5 FIXED)
Dashboard button visible on AgiloftIntegration page (Bug #5 FIXED)

critical_code_review_comments: Reserved clause filtering is implemented in /app/backend/acqgov_scraper.py - lines 189-191, 224-226, 388-390, 425-427 check for 'reserved' in title and skip those clauses
The upload-missing-clauses endpoint uses create_clause (not upsert_clause) as mentioned in the bug fix notes

context_for_next_testing_agent: All reported bugs have been fixed and tested: 1) Note saving works (MongoDB _id fix), 2) PDF export works with JSON body, 3) Save search works (MongoDB _id fix), 4) AI toggle no longer auto-triggers search, 5) Dashboard button appears on all three pages when authenticated, 6) Reserved clause filtering is implemented in acqgov_scraper.py. The upload-missing-clauses endpoint was not directly tested as it requires Agiloft credentials.
